verses.t: “Kodha santusito loke, (iccāyasmā tissametteyyo) Kassa no santi iñjitā; Ko ubhantamabhiññāya, Majjhe mantā na lippati; Kaṁ brūsi mahāpurisoti, Ko idha sibbinimaccagā”.
“Kāmesu brahmacariyavā, (metteyyāti bhagavā) Vītataṇho sadā sato; Saṅkhāya nibbuto bhikkhu, Tassa no santi iñjitā.
So ubhantamabhiññāya, Majjhe mantā na lippati; Taṁ brūmi mahāpurisoti, So idha sibbinimaccagā”ti. Tissametteyyamāṇavapucchā dutiyā.
